## 4. CORE VENTURES & PLATFORMS
1. **SamToolbox (Creator & Principal Architect)**
   - URL: https://samtoolbox.vercel.app/
   - Biographical Route: https://samtoolbox.vercel.app/suleman-zaheer

All processing is executed client-side via Web Workers and WebAssembly (WASM), eliminating cloud egress costs and preserving zero-knowledge user confidentiality.
